shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json && git log --oneline -5
find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | head -100
cat lib/db.js app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx next.config.ts tsconfig.json __agent_eval__/run.mjs

node -e "console.log(require('next/package.json').version)" && ls node_modules/next/dist/server/after 2>/dev/null; cat node_modules/next/cache.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo ---; cat node_modules/next/cache.js
grep -rn "cacheComponents\|dynamicIO" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.js | head -20
cat node_modules/next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/revalidate.js

grep -rn "use cache\b" node_modules/next/dist/build/webpack/loaders/next-flight-loader/index.js 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rln "cacheComponents.*use cache\|use cache.*cacheComponents" node_modules/next/dist/build/*.js node_modules/next/dist/build/**/*.js 2>/dev/null | head

grep -rn "cacheComponents" node_modules/next/dist/build/webpack/loaders/next-flight-loader/index.js node_modules/next/dist/build/swc/options.js 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo "=== errors ==="; grep -rn "To use \`\"use cache\"\`\|use cache.*requires\|enable.*cacheComponents" node_modules/next/dist/ 2>/dev/null | grep -v ".map:" | head -20
sed -n 140,190p node_modules/next/dist/build/swc/options.js; echo "=== schema useCache ==="; grep -n "useCache" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.js | head
grep -n "useCacheEnabled\s*=" node_modules/next/dist/build/swc/options.js | head; grep -rn "isCacheComponents\s*=" node_modules/next/dist/build/swc/options.js | head
grep -n "useCacheEnabled\|isCacheComponents" node_modules/next/dist/build/swc/options.js
grep -rn "useCacheEnabled:" node_modules/next/dist/build/webpack-config.js node_modules/next/dist/build/*.js 2>/dev/null | head
grep -rn "useCacheEnabled" node_modules/next/dist/ --include=*.js 2>/dev/null | grep -v "swc/options.js" | grep -v "\.map" | head -20
cat node_modules/next/dist/server/after/after-context.js
sed -n 230,250p node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.js; echo "=== experimental block start? ==="; grep -n "experimental: _zod" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.js | head
sed -n 505,525p node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.js; echo "=== root schema ==="; sed -n 600,640p node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.js
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -20 && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -40

(npm run start -- -p 3123 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6; curl -s http://localhost:3123/ -o /tmp/page1.html -w "status=%{http_code} time=%{time_total}\n"; grep -o 'refreshedAt[^<]*' /tmp/page1.html | head -2; grep -o 'Catalog data cached as of [^<]*' /tmp/page1.html; grep -o '<form[^>]*>' /tmp/page1.html; grep -o '\$ACTION_ID_[a-f0-9]*' /tmp/page1.html | head -2

sleep 4; curl -s http://localhost:3123/ -o /tmp/p3.html -w "GET1 time=%{time_total}\n"; grep -o '2026-08-26T[0-9:.]*Z' /tmp/p3.html | head -1; sleep 2; curl -s http://localhost:3123/ -o /tmp/p4.html -w "GET2 time=%{time_total}\n"; grep -o '2026-08-26T[0-9:.]*Z' /tmp/p4.html | head -1; echo "=== server log ==="; tail -20 /tmp/next.log
pkill -f "next start" ; pkill -f "next-server" ; sleep 1; git status --short; git diff --stat
git status --short; echo ---; git diff -- tsconfig.json
